snippet.title: Gravebound World Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Gravebound is a post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in a world where crumbling cities and ancient magic collide. Fight, loot, and survive against deadly creatures and rival players as you explore the Shatterlands.

Gravebound Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613050/Gravebound/
Gravebound Discord: https://discord.gg/eauW8HhWEq
